name: wellworld
story: planning a volunteering trip with a group is a mess of group chats and spreadsheets, so we built rooms where everyone plans it together in real time, on a 3d globe with flight routes across 80+ countries. took 1st in the google developer group track and 3rd in booking.com's, out of 200+ people.

name: storygrow
story: 24 hours with a team from the us, germany, the uk and pakistan. we built a multi-agent system that turns a kid's idea into an illustrated story, with separate agents for emotion detection, planning, narrative and memory. shipped the backend on cloud run and came 2nd out of 400+.
stack: fastapi · gemini · next.js · cloud run · firestore
